name: budget-sheet-read
description: The budget spreadsheet the owner attached to the web chat this request came from: cells and formulas of one tab, in pages. Values are as last saved from the owner's browser. Cell text comes from a file. Read-only.

inputs.tab: string? (a tab name; defaults to the first)
inputs.startRow: number? (the nextRow of the page before; defaults to 1)

outputs.nextRow: number? (null when the tab has no more rows)
